description: The NEGATIVE keywords (excluded searches) on a Microsoft Advertising campaign (campaignId) or ad group (adGroupId) with their ids and match types; with no id, the account’s SHARED negative keyword lists; with listId, the keywords in one list. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

adGroupId.description: ad group whose negative keywords to list

campaignId.description: campaign whose negative keywords to list

name: list_microsoft_ads_negative_keywords
title: List Microsoft Advertising negative keywords
